title: Plug-in compatibility: FileMaker Go (iOS)
description: Plug-in function calls in scope that cannot run on FileMaker Go (iOS): FileMaker Go supports no plug-ins (generic rule, applies to every vendor - independent of the MBS 'iOS SDK' column, which covers Claris iOS SDK apps). Includes one-level custom-function wrappers (via_custom_function) and layout/field calculation usages (evidence_kind='layout').
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: FileMaker Go does not support plug-ins at all (Claris documentation) - every plug-in function call fails there, regardless of vendor. The MBS 'iOS SDK' column covers Claris iOS SDK apps and never feeds this signal.
rule.remediation: Guard or replace plug-in calls for FileMaker Go (e.g. branch on Get(Device) or move the work to a server script via Perform Script on Server).

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: Plug-in function calls in scope that do not run on FileMaker Go (iOS)
